sourceInventory.evidenceStatus: Product declaration only, not account-history, deployment, entitlement or source qualification evidence. Required approvals and source-specific rights remain unchanged.

guardrails: No new paid contract, shared credential, account, production mutation, tracker, advertising tag, email, scan, or external request is created by this branch.
A historical record is not proof of current entitlement, usable credentials, approval, or a suitable OffMenu data-processing arrangement.
Client analytics, diagnostics, consent, feedback, and advertising are disabled unless a validated THIRD_PARTY_CONFIG explicitly enables them.

dispositions.name: existing-foundation
dispositions.feature: Cloudflare Worker/D1 application, Netlify Identity with managed Google sign-in, source hosting and the existing public food-data adapters.
conditions: Keep account data private and source responses transient as implemented.
Confirm existing plan, binding, sender, and OAuth settings before a production change.

dispositions.name: implement-or-configure-after-qualification
dispositions.feature: Error diagnostics, explicit-send support email, feedback, consent, coarse consent-gated analytics, discoverability, uptime, and optional quality gates.
conditions: Sentry captures only filtered technical errors; no pantry, health, receipt, token, or identity content.
Brevo sends only explicit transactional/support messages after sender, recipient, retention, and unsubscribe duties are confirmed.
iubenda blocks optional client services until consent; Sleekplan is loaded only after its product/board configuration is qualified.
Zaraz stays coarse and consent-gated. Search Console and Bing are verification/configuration work, not client tracking.
Snyk and Sonar execute only in credential-qualified CI; no account setup or fabricated scan result.

dispositions.name: conditional-product-direction
dispositions.action: defer until the named product decision and provider approval
dispositions.feature: Advertising, native/mobile delivery, retailer data, credentialed nutrition search, partner health/activity imports.
conditions: AdSense is permitted only after OffMenu site approval, privacy/consent configuration, and a conscious monetisation decision. AdMob and Funding Choices require a native/app or approved Google flow.
Credentialed data providers require an OffMenu-specific key/account and terms, quota, attribution, caching, and privacy review.
Retail, health, and activity integrations require their own approval/OAuth/native bridge and explicit user consent.

dispositions.name: external-approval-or-licence-blocked
dispositions.action: do not integrate until documented external permission exists
dispositions.feature: Regional food data and inspections with stated permission, membership, account, or terms-review requirements.
conditions: Record written permission, approved account, licence, attribution, allowed use, geography, retention, and refresh policy before code or import work.

dispositions.name: terms-review-before-import
dispositions.action: keep registry reference; do not automate collection
dispositions.feature: Food composition and food-safety sources where current terms, licence, access method, or dataset scope needs a source-specific review.
conditions: Use public-reference links only until the source-specific review approves collection and publication.

integrity.verification: Every inventory record ID appears exactly once in dispositions[].recordIds; verify-third-party-config tests configuration, and the service-document test checks this register against the source inventory.

scope: Product-only provider/source slice; no shared orchestration or cross-project account inventory.
